item.title: Karatsu Morning Market — Guide
item.description: Karatsu’s morning market is a small, friendly street market that brings the everyday life of this castle and fishing town to life in the early hours. Local vendors — many of them older women from the surrounding area and coast — line the street with their stalls, selling the freshest catch from the Genkai Sea, seasonal vegetables and fruit, homemade pickles, dried fish and seaweed, and local specialties, often straight from their own boats and farms.
